description:
## Dual VoT Patches 1.43.0-dualvot.8.5.3

YouTube 21.37 playback compatibility fix for the stable Morphe 1.43.0 line.

### Fixed

- Regular videos and Shorts no longer fail to load because of obsolete DataSpec field names.
- Swiping to the next Short no longer crashes the app.
- Media DataSpec fields and header/cache-key registers are resolved dynamically across YouTube versions.

### Validation

- Regression tests cover dynamic field and register resolution.
- Android patch bundle compiled successfully.
- Confirmed on an Android device with YouTube 21.37.42: videos and Shorts load normally and swiping between Shorts is stable.
